blocks.html:
While The Goal Of Our Workshops Is To Provide You With The Skill Set To Learn Alternative Processes, Students Often Prefer To Use Their Own Images To See How The Process Applies To Their Work.

In Collaboration With Our Digital Negative Instructor, Morgan Post, We Have Created A Service To Aid In The Printing Of Digital Negatives Used For Printing Out Processes. Morgan Has Provided Us With The Necessary Information To Prepare A Digital Negative From Your Digital Or Scanned Image.

For Further Details Please Contact: Molly@Penumbrafoundation.Org
